title: Cull and edit RAW on the road
description: Check the frames, make the edits you need and pass the file on without having to go back to a computer.

blocks.text: On the road you want to cull the camera’s shots and make the edits you need before getting back to a computer. The whole path matters: import the file, judge the frame and pass the result on.

quote.text: I use this app in pro form to make raw photos pop. Such a quick workflow even for my digital camera without having to use a Desktop computer

blocks.text: Carrying the edit through to a result

After importing, the person flags the shots he has chosen and edits them. The source files and the results are saved separately; it is clear where the version for continuing the work on a computer is.
Where the idea has an advantage

The first version needs a tested set of cameras and formats. The word RAW in a description proves nothing about whether the process works. If the handover loses changes or metadata, the mobile stage adds work instead of saving time.
